# Pipeline Architecture Diagrams

## 1. Complete Pipeline Flowchart

```{mermaid}
flowchart TD
    Start([Git Push Triggered]) --> PreBuild["🔧 PRE-BUILD HOOK<br/>Checkout code<br/>Install deps"]
    PreBuild --> BuildStart["START BUILD PHASE<br/>(Parallel Execution)"]

    BuildStart --> Compiler["📦 COMPILER<br/>TypeScript/Go/Rust<br/>Build artifacts"]
    BuildStart --> Linter["📝 LINTER<br/>ESLint/Prettier<br/>Code formatting"]
    BuildStart --> Security["🔒 SECURITY SCANNER<br/>Snyk/Trivy<br/>Vulnerability check"]

    Compiler --> BuildHook{"🎯 BUILD-SUCCESS<br/>HOOK"}
    Linter --> BuildHook
    Security --> BuildHook

    BuildHook -->|Any failed (Exit 2)| BuildFail["❌ BUILD FAILED<br/>Stop pipeline<br/>Notify team"]
    BuildFail --> End1([Release Blocked])

    BuildHook -->|All pass (Exit 0)| TestStart["START TEST PHASE<br/>(Parallel Execution)"]

    TestStart --> Unit["🧪 UNIT TESTER<br/>Jest/Vitest<br/>Component tests<br/>8 min"]
    TestStart --> Integration["🔗 INTEGRATION TESTER<br/>API tests<br/>Database tests<br/>12 min"]
    TestStart --> E2E["🎬 E2E TESTER<br/>Playwright<br/>User flows<br/>15 min"]

    Unit --> QualityGate{"🏆 QUALITY GATE<br/>HOOK"}
    Integration --> QualityGate
    E2E --> QualityGate

    QualityGate -->|Coverage <80% | QualityFail["❌ QUALITY GATE<br/>FAILED<br/>Coverage too low"]
    QualityGate -->|Critical bugs | QualityFail
    QualityFail --> End2([Release Blocked])

    QualityGate -->|All pass (Exit 0)| DeployStart["START DEPLOY PHASE<br/>(Sequential)"]

    DeployStart --> Staging["🚀 STAGING DEPLOYER<br/>Deploy to staging env<br/>5 min"]
    Staging --> StagingHealth{"🏥 HEALTH CHECK<br/>HOOK"}

    StagingHealth -->|Unhealthy| Rollback1["⚠️ ROLLBACK<br/>Staging failed"]
    Rollback1 --> End3([Release Blocked])

    StagingHealth -->|Healthy| Canary["🐤 CANARY DEPLOYER<br/>Deploy to 5% prod<br/>3 min"]
    Canary --> CanaryHealth{"🏥 HEALTH CHECK<br/>HOOK<br/>Monitor 5 min"}

    CanaryHealth -->|Error rate >1%| RollbackCanary["⚠️ AUTO-ROLLBACK<br/>Revert canary<br/>5 min"]
    RollbackCanary --> End4([Release Failed])

    CanaryHealth -->|Latency >500ms| RollbackCanary
    CanaryHealth -->|Healthy| Production["✅ PRODUCTION DEPLOYER<br/>Deploy to 100% prod<br/>10 min"]

    Production --> ProdHealth{"🏥 FINAL HEALTH<br/>CHECK HOOK<br/>Monitor 10 min"}

    ProdHealth -->|Unhealthy| AutoRollback["🔄 AUTO-ROLLBACK<br/>Revert to prev version<br/>5 min"]
    AutoRollback --> IncidentAlert["🚨 Alert team<br/>PagerDuty notification"]
    IncidentAlert --> End5([Release Rolled Back])

    ProdHealth -->|Healthy| Success["✅ RELEASE SUCCESS<br/>60 min total<br/>Update changelog"]
    Success --> Notify["📢 Notify team<br/>Slack/Email"]
    Notify --> End6([Release Complete])

    style BuildFail fill:#ff6b6b
    style QualityFail fill:#ff6b6b
    style Rollback1 fill:#ffa500
    style RollbackCanary fill:#ffa500
    style AutoRollback fill:#ff6b6b
    style Success fill:#51cf66
    style End6 fill:#51cf66
```

## 2. Pipeline State Diagram

Shows states and transitions through the pipeline:

```{mermaid}
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> PreBuild: Git push event

    PreBuild --> Building: Checkout code

    Building --> BuildValidation: Parallel<br/>Compiler, Linter,<br/>Security Scanner

    BuildValidation --> BuildSuccess: Exit 0
    BuildValidation --> BuildFailed: Exit 2

    BuildFailed --> [*]: Stop

    BuildSuccess --> Testing: Continue

    Testing --> TestValidation: Parallel<br/>Unit, Integration,<br/>E2E tests

    TestValidation --> QualityCheck: All tests done

    QualityCheck --> QualityPass: Coverage OK<br/>No critical bugs
    QualityCheck --> QualityFail: Coverage low<br/>Critical bugs found

    QualityFail --> [*]: Stop

    QualityPass --> StagingDeploy: Continue

    StagingDeploy --> StagingHealthCheck: 5 min monitoring
    StagingHealthCheck --> StagingOK: Healthy
    StagingHealthCheck --> StagingFailed: Unhealthy

    StagingFailed --> [*]: Rollback

    StagingOK --> CanaryDeploy: 5% traffic

    CanaryDeploy --> CanaryMonitor: 5 min monitoring
    CanaryMonitor --> CanaryOK: Error rate <1%
    CanaryMonitor --> CanaryFailed: Error rate >1%

    CanaryFailed --> RollbackCanary: Auto-rollback
    RollbackCanary --> [*]: Release Failed

    CanaryOK --> ProductionDeploy: 100% traffic

    ProductionDeploy --> ProdMonitor: 10 min monitoring
    ProdMonitor --> ProdOK: Healthy
    ProdMonitor --> ProdFailed: Unhealthy

    ProdFailed --> RollbackProd: Auto-rollback
    RollbackProd --> [*]: Release Failed

    ProdOK --> PostValidation: Success
    PostValidation --> [*]: Release Complete

    note right of BuildValidation
        Max parallel time = 5 min
        (longest agent)
    end note

    note right of TestValidation
        Max parallel time = 15 min
        (E2E tests)
    end note

    note right of CanaryMonitor
        Catches 95% of bugs
        before full deploy
    end note
```

## 3. Sequence Diagram: Pipeline Execution

Shows interactions between agents and hooks:

```{mermaid}
sequenceDiagram
    participant Git as Git Webhook
    participant Orchestrator as Release-Manager<br/>Orchestrator
    participant Build as Build<br/>Subcommand
    participant Compiler as Compiler<br/>Agent
    participant Linter as Linter<br/>Agent
    participant Security as Security<br/>Agent
    participant BuildHook as Build-Success<br/>Hook
    participant Test as Test<br/>Subcommand
    participant QualityHook as Quality-Gate<br/>Hook
    participant Deploy as Deploy<br/>Subcommand
    participant Canary as Canary<br/>Deployer
    participant HealthHook as Health-Check<br/>Hook

    Git->>Orchestrator: New push on main<br/>(trigger pipeline)
    activate Orchestrator

    Orchestrator->>Build: Start BUILD phase
    activate Build

    Build->>Compiler: Compile code
    Build->>Linter: Lint code
    Build->>Security: Scan vulns

    activate Compiler
    Compiler-->>Build: ✅ Exit 0
    deactivate Compiler

    activate Linter
    Linter-->>Build: ✅ Exit 0
    deactivate Linter

    activate Security
    Security-->>Build: ✅ Exit 0
    deactivate Security

    Build->>BuildHook: All agents done
    activate BuildHook
    BuildHook->>BuildHook: Check all Exit 0
    BuildHook-->>Build: ✅ Proceed
    deactivate BuildHook
    deactivate Build

    Orchestrator->>Test: Start TEST phase
    activate Test
    Test->>Test: Unit tests (parallel)
    Test->>Test: Integration tests (parallel)
    Test->>Test: E2E tests (parallel)
    Test-->>Orchestrator: All tests complete
    deactivate Test

    Orchestrator->>QualityHook: Quality gate validation
    activate QualityHook
    QualityHook->>QualityHook: Check coverage ≥80%
    QualityHook->>QualityHook: Check no critical bugs
    QualityHook-->>Orchestrator: ✅ Quality pass
    deactivate QualityHook

    Orchestrator->>Deploy: Start DEPLOY phase
    activate Deploy

    Deploy->>Canary: Deploy to 5% canary
    activate Canary
    Canary->>Canary: Configure traffic split<br/>5% new, 95% old
    Canary-->>Deploy: Canary deployed
    deactivate Canary

    Deploy->>HealthHook: Canary health check
    activate HealthHook
    HealthHook->>HealthHook: Monitor error rate
    HealthHook->>HealthHook: Monitor latency
    HealthHook-->>Deploy: ✅ Healthy
    deactivate HealthHook

    Deploy->>Deploy: Deploy to 100% prod
    Deploy-->>Orchestrator: Deploy complete
    deactivate Deploy

    Orchestrator->>Orchestrator: Post-deploy validation
    Orchestrator-->>Git: ✅ Release Complete
    deactivate Orchestrator
```

## 5. Error Handling Flowchart

Shows what happens when things fail:

```{mermaid}
flowchart TD
    Error{Error Detected}

    Error -->|Build Failed| BuildErr["❌ COMPILATION ERROR<br/>Exit 2"]
    BuildErr --> BuildLog["📋 Log error<br/>Point to failing line"]
    BuildLog --> BuildNotify["📢 Slack #releases<br/>'Build failed on line X'"]
    BuildNotify --> Cleanup1["🧹 Cleanup<br/>Remove partial artifacts"]
    Cleanup1 --> EndBuild([Stop Pipeline])

    Error -->|Test Failed| TestErr["❌ TEST FAILURE<br/>Exit 2"]
    TestErr --> TestDetail["📊 Capture<br/>Failed test name<br/>Error message<br/>Stack trace"]
    TestDetail --> Screenshot["📸 Screenshot/Video<br/>For E2E failures"]
    Screenshot --> TestNotify["📢 Slack #qa<br/>Link to test results"]
    TestNotify --> EndTest([Stop Pipeline])

    Error -->|Quality Gate| QualityErr["❌ QUALITY GATE FAILED"]
    QualityErr --> QualityDetail{"What failed?"}

    QualityDetail -->|Coverage <80%| CoverageIssue["📉 Coverage: 72%<br/>Need +8%<br/>List uncovered files"]
    QualityDetail -->|Critical Bug| BugIssue["🐛 Critical bugs:<br/>SQL Injection in User.js<br/>Remote Code Exec in Parser.js"]
    QualityDetail -->|Perf Failed| PerfIssue["⚡ Latency p95: 450ms<br/>Threshold: 200ms<br/>Profile slow functions"]

    CoverageIssue --> QualityNotify["📢 Slack #engineering<br/>Coverage report link"]
    BugIssue --> QualityNotify
    PerfIssue --> QualityNotify
    QualityNotify --> EndQuality([Stop Pipeline])

    Error -->|Canary Failed| CanaryErr["⚠️ CANARY HEALTH ISSUE"]
    CanaryErr --> CanaryDetail{"What failed?"}

    CanaryDetail -->|High Error Rate| ErrorRate["Error rate: 3%<br/>Threshold: <1%<br/>Rollback triggered"]
    CanaryDetail -->|High Latency| Latency["Latency p95: 800ms<br/>Threshold: 500ms<br/>Rollback triggered"]

    ErrorRate --> RollbackCanary["🔄 AUTO-ROLLBACK<br/>kubectl rollout undo"]
    Latency --> RollbackCanary
    RollbackCanary --> VerifyRollback["✅ Verify old version<br/>is healthy again"]
    VerifyRollback --> CanaryAlert["🚨 PagerDuty alert<br/>Investigate regression"]
    CanaryAlert --> EndCanary([Release Failed])

    Error -->|Production Failed| ProdErr["🚨 PRODUCTION FAILURE"]
    ProdErr --> ProdDetail["Failure in:<br/>Health check<br/>Monitoring alerts"]
    ProdDetail --> ProdRollback["🔄 IMMEDIATE ROLLBACK<br/>k8s + DB + CDN revert<br/>5 min max"]
    ProdRollback --> ProdRestore["✅ Verify old version<br/>Error rate <0.5%"]
    ProdRestore --> IncidentMgmt["🚨 INCIDENT RESPONSE<br/>Page on-call engineer<br/>Create incident in PagerDuty<br/>Post to #incidents"]
    IncidentMgmt --> Investigation["🔍 Investigate what<br/>caused production issue<br/>Add test case to prevent"]
    Investigation --> EndProd([Release Rolled Back])

    style BuildErr fill:#ff6b6b
    style TestErr fill:#ff6b6b
    style QualityErr fill:#ffa500
    style CanaryErr fill:#ffa500
    style ProdErr fill:#ff0000
    style RollbackCanary fill:#ff9900
    style ProdRollback fill:#ff0000
    style EndBuild fill:#ff6b6b
    style EndTest fill:#ff6b6b
    style EndQuality fill:#ff6b6b
    style EndCanary fill:#ff9900
    style EndProd fill:#ff0000
```

```{mermaid}
    T25 --> T30["T+30min<br/>STAGING<br/>DEPLOYED"]
    T30 --> Hook3a["🏥 HOOK 3a<br/>Health-Check<br/>Staging health"]

    Hook3a -->|Fail| Stop3["❌ STOP"]
    Hook3a -->|Pass| T33["T+33min<br/>CANARY<br/>DEPLOYED<br/>5% traffic"]

    T33 --> T38["T+38min<br/>MONITORING<br/>CANARY"]

    Hook3b -->|Fail| Rollback["⚠️ AUTO-ROLLBACK<br/>Revert canary<br/>5 min"]
    Hook3b -->|Pass| T43["T+43min<br/>PRODUCTION<br/>DEPLOYED<br/>100% traffic"]

    T43 --> T53["T+53min<br/>MONITORING<br/>PRODUCTION"]
    T53 --> Hook4["🔄 HOOK 4<br/>Rollback-on-Error<br/>Final health check"]

    Hook4 -->|Fail| RollbackProd["🔄 AUTO-ROLLBACK<br/>Production revert"]
    Hook4 -->|Pass| Success["✅ SUCCESS<br/>T+60min"]

    Rollback --> Incident["🚨 Incident"]
    RollbackProd --> Incident

```

# Key Diagram Insights

## Parallelization Benefits

- **Build**: 3 agents run simultaneously → 5 min (vs 12 min sequential)
- **Test**: 3 test suites run simultaneously → 15 min (vs 35 min sequential)
- **Overall Speedup**: 60 min automated vs 300+ min manual = 6x faster

## Hook Placement Strategy

1. **Build-Success** → After compilation, before testing
   - Fail fast if code won't compile
2. **Quality-Gate** → After testing, before deployment
   - Prevent low-quality code from reaching production
3. **Health-Check** → After each deployment
   - Detect issues immediately (staging, canary, prod)
4. **Rollback-on-Error** → Triggered by health-check failures
   - Automatic recovery within 5 minutes

## Risk Mitigation Flow

```
Canary = Early detection
  ↓
If canary fails, auto-rollback before full deploy
  ↓
If production fails, instant auto-rollback + incident alert
  ↓
No user impact (canary catches 95% of bugs)
```
